body.x: The Incheon Free Economic Zone Authority (Incheon Free Economic Zone, hereinafter IFEZ Authority) announced on the 18th that it will participate in CES, the world’s largest information technology exhibition, for the third consecutive year to present Incheon’s AI city vision on the global stage.

From January 6 to 9 next year, at CES 2026 in Las Vegas, the United States, the IFEZ Authority will operate the ‘Incheon City–IFEZ Pavilion’ under the theme “Destination Incheon—From Smart City to AI City: The Next Evolution of Urban Life.”

CES (Consumer Electronics Show) takes place every January in Las Vegas and serves as a global platform where the latest technology trends and business opportunities converge. The IFEZ Authority will set up the pavilion in the AI Zone of the North Hall at the Las Vegas Convention Center (LVCC).

The CES 2026 Incheon City–IFEZ Pavilion will consist of the AI Smart Living Zone, which enhances citizen services such as mobility, safety, energy, and health; the AI Innovation Hub Zone, which drives innovation across industrial sites including manufacturing, logistics, food, and pharmaceuticals; and the AI Creative City Zone, which creates content and experiences. Through these zones, the pavilion will showcase Incheon’s innovative technologies as the city evolves beyond a smart city into an AI city.

On the opening day, January 6, following the opening ceremony, the main stage inside the Incheon City–IFEZ Pavilion will host various programs, including a Global AI City Session. Global city and industry experts will gather to discuss practical collaboration strategies to support Incheon’s leap from a smart city to an AI city.

On the second day, the ‘CES 2026 INCHEON Night’ event will bring together participating Incheon companies and overseas firms for networking aimed at fostering practical cooperation. Investors, buyers, and global partners will join the exchange, with partnership discussions and demo showcases taking place throughout the event.

On January 8, the authority will operate an intensive business day for 15 visiting companies, supporting overseas expansion through one-on-one matching and on-site meetings with buyers, venture capital firms, and accelerators.

The IFEZ Authority will showcase technologies from 10 innovative companies within the zone and support the CES participation of 51 companies, including 10 in the Eureka Park Integrated Korea Pavilion, 6 in the Global Pavilion Korea Pavilion, 15 visiting companies, and 10 showcase companies. Beyond simple exhibition participation, the authority will strengthen support by linking investor and global partner meetings, demo showcases, and local networking to achieve tangible global expansion outcomes.

The IFEZ Authority has prepared startups to participate in CES through programs such as pre-arranged business matching, global media meetups, training for international exhibitions, and support for the CES Innovation Awards. In particular, 14 companies won 17 CES Innovation Awards, the highest total ever. This year, given the record number of Innovation Awards, the authority plans to provide additional support by operating a CES Innovation Award Showcase for award-winning companies, further enhancing global visibility and follow-up business opportunities.

Incheon Mayor Jeong-bok Yoo said, “CES 2026 is an important opportunity to elevate the global capabilities of Incheon and its companies to the next level.” He added, “Under the ‘Destination Incheon’ theme, we will share IFEZ’s AI city strategy with the world and do our utmost to position Incheon not as a city people simply pass through, but as a destination the world heads toward and a global innovation city in the AI era.”
Detailed information on participating companies and programs is available through the official CES 2026 INCHEON-IFEZ website.

Incheon Metropolitan City and the Incheon Free Economic Zone Authority announced that they will establish the INCHEON-IFEZ Pavilion in the LVCC North Hall at CES 2026, showcasing Incheon’s urban vision and innovative technologies as the city evolves from smart city development into the AI era. By linking various exhibition programs—including the 10 companies participating in the INCHEON-IFEZ Pavilion, Eureka Park, global pavilions, and the CES Innovation Award Showcase—the organizations will support the participation of 51 Incheon-based innovative companies at CES. Notably, 14 companies received CES Innovation Awards across 17 categories, marking a record-high achievement and demonstrating the technological competitiveness and global growth potential of Incheon’s innovation companies.
